name: Oshiero! ~Aiyoku no Houteishiki~
source:
I'm a home tutor and my students are all very cute girls.
Nonohara Miu is a girl who is athletic but has a little trouble with her studies.
Tsukimiya Shiori is a high class girl from a prestigious family who is the perfect portrait of a girl with both brains and beauty.
Now am I going to teach these girls about love or lust...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038139.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是家庭教師，而我的學生全都是可愛的女孩。
野原美羽擅長運動，但課業上有些吃力。
月宮詩織出身名門，是兼具智慧與美貌的完美女孩。
現在，我究竟要教這些女孩愛情，還是慾望呢……

[來源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE038139.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
